# cycle_integrations (Data Source)

Lists all Cycle hub integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every integration in the hub.
data "cycle_integrations" "all" {}

output "integration_names" {
  value = [for i in data.cycle_integrations.all.integrations : i.name]
}

output "live_integration_ids" {
  value = [
    for i in data.cycle_integrations.all.integrations : i.id
    if i.state == "live"
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `integrations` (Attributes List) All integrations in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `auth` (Attributes) Vendor-specific authentication credentials. Sensitive fields are often omitted by the API after create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations--auth))
- `extra` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional vendor-specific key-value pairs.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this integration belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the integration.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the integration.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the integration.
- `state` (String) The current state of the integration.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor this integration is associated with.

<a id="nestedatt--integrations--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations.auth`

Read-Only:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for accessing the integration.
- `base64_config` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded configuration for the integration.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client ID for the integration.
- `key_id` (String, Sensitive) Key ID for accessing the integration.
- `namespace` (String, Sensitive) The namespace associated with the integration.
- `region` (String, Sensitive) The region associated with the integration.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret for accessing the integration.
- `subscription_id` (String, Sensitive) Subscription ID for the integration.
